name: Nashiki Yua
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c110157]Ria's[/url] mother.
She has been hit on by countless men over the years, yet possesses an abnormally high ability to avoid danger and has never once gotten into trouble. 

However, she is a bigger troublemaker than her daughter Ria, possessing a bewitching charm and cuteness that allows her to almost certainly seduce anyone she sets her sights on.  

She is [url=https://vndb.org/c169460]Kokona’s[/url] junior from their school days, she knows all about Kokona’s true cool and stylish gyaru era. She has been deeply devoted to her ever since, but she feels inwardly dissatisfied with the “façade” Kokona has been putting on since getting married.  

She is quite fond of [url=https://vndb.org/c169626]Shouta[/url]. With the mindset that “for Ria to marry Shouta, he needs to become completely obsessed with her mom as well,” she takes full advantage of the protagonists assistance with her diet and relentlessly, without the slightest hesitation, keeps making sexual advances.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1368656/]Getchu[/url]]
